rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for an overall effect or a vague belief or feeling about something.

example.english: That film left quite an impression on me.
example.traditional: 嗰套戲畀我嘅印象幾深。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 bei2 ngo5 ge3 jan3 zoeng6 gei2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for the outward appearance or look of a person or thing, rather than its effect on someone.

example.english: His appearance really makes quite an impression.
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 joeng2 zan1 hai6 gei2 coeng2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this for a physical indentation or dent left by pressure.

example.english: There is a dent in the tabletop, an impression made by something heavy.
example.traditional: 張枱面有個凹痕，應該係重嘢壓出嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi4 min6 jau5 go3 ngaau1 han4 jing1 goi1 hai6 zung6 je5 aat3 ceot1 lei4 ge3
